tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Lists email threads from the authenticated user's Gmail account, optionally filtered with a Gmail-syntax query.

pageSize.description: Maximum threads to return; default 20, max 50.

pageToken.description: Token for a specific page of results.

view.description: Which fields are populated in the thread list.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Retrieves a specific email thread from the authenticated user's Gmail account, including a list of its messages.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to fetch.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Retrieves a specific email message by its unique message ID. For full conversations use get_thread.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message to fetch.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Creates a new draft email in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

body.description: Main body content; plain-text alternative if htmlBody is set.

replyToMessageId.description: ID of the message to reply to.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: Lists draft emails from the authenticated user's Gmail account, optionally filtered with a query.

pageSize.description: Maximum drafts to return; default 20, max 50.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: Lists all user-defined labels in the authenticated user's Gmail account. Call first to find a label's ID.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Creates a new label in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

displayName.description: The display name of the label to create.

color.description: Optional textColor and backgroundColor hex strings.

tools.name: label_message
tools.description: Adds one or more labels to a specific message.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to add the labels to.

labelIds.description: The IDs of the labels to add. System label IDs (INBOX, STARRED, UNREAD, IMPORTANT) or user label IDs, not names.

tools.name: unlabel_message
tools.description: Removes one or more labels from a specific message.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to remove the labels from.

labelIds.description: The IDs of the labels to remove. System label IDs (INBOX, STARRED, UNREAD, IMPORTANT) or user label IDs, not names.

tools.name: label_thread
tools.description: Adds labels to an entire thread, applying to all current and future messages in it.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to add labels to.

labelIds.description: The IDs of the labels to add. System label IDs (INBOX, STARRED, UNREAD, IMPORTANT) or user label IDs, not names.

tools.name: unlabel_thread
tools.description: Removes labels from an entire thread.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to remove labels from.

labelIds.description: The IDs of the labels to remove. System label IDs (INBOX, STARRED, UNREAD, IMPORTANT) or user label IDs, not names.
